slots.name: effectiveness of interceptor drones
slots.sentence: He said interceptor drones currently available to Ukraine, which could theoretically intercept jet-powered drones, have not yet demonstrated the expected effectiveness, though Ukraine is working on solutions.

slots.name: daily drone launch target
slots.sentence: In his evening statement to the nation Friday, Zelenskyy said Kyiv hoped to increase its long-range strikes to reach 1000 drone launches every day.

slots.name: Russian use of jet-powered drones
slots.sentence: Although officials haven’t said whether they were used in the warehouse attack, Russia has significantly increased its use of jet-powered drones, and their numbers will keep growing as Moscow sees their effectiveness, Pavlo Palisa, deputy head of Ukraine’s presidential office, told reporters Friday.

slots.name: average daily long-range drone launches
slots.sentence: “Right now, we average over 300 of our long-range sanctions,” Zelenskyy said
